'''Im'Toral XV''' was the [[En'Tra]], or "King-Master" of [[Coyn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As En'Tra, Im'Toral ruled over the 29 [[Ag'Tra]], or noble families, and was married to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Em'Tora VIII]].
